title: Personal Loans Refinance Desk Card: Refinance-Purpose Payoff Quotes and the Payoff Quote Tool
content:
## The rule

A refinance-purpose payoff quote on a Larkspur Personal Loans loan states the single amount that retires the loan when the payoff transfer from a Larkspur refinance loan arrives by the quote's good-through date. It is issued only for a loan in active status, at most one per loan for the same quote date, and it does not change the loan. Its good-through date and its payoff amount are worked out under the refinance-purpose quote rule of Personal Loans; a quote for any other purpose follows the payoff quote terms.

A loan with no unpaid principal is not quoted; on a loan with unpaid principal the payoff amount is always above 0.00 and the quote is recorded.

## The payoff quote tool

**What it does.** `issue_payoff_quote_88f1b45e` records one payoff quote on a Personal Loans loan, dated today, with the purpose given, stating the single amount that pays the loan in full if received by the good-through date. The loan itself, its balances and its schedule are not changed. Once recorded, the quote can be seen among the loan's payoff quotes with its purpose, amount and good-through date.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_payoff_quote_88f1b45e` and then calls it with the parameters below.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | reference number of the personal loan being quoted, as returned by the loan lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | reference number of the borrower who owns that loan, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `quote_purpose` | why the quote is issued | exactly one of `borrower_payoff` (the borrower will pay the loan off directly), `refinance` (a Larkspur refinance loan will pay the loan off by internal transfer), `third_party_lender` (another lender will pay the loan off, on the borrower's authorization) |
| `good_through_date` | last calendar date on which the quoted amount is valid | YYYY-MM-DD in Eastern Time; no empty value |
| `payoff_amount` | the quoted payoff amount in US dollars | decimal number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Payoff quote <quote id> issued on loan <loan id> for <purpose>: quote date <YYYY-MM-DD>, good through <YYYY-MM-DD>, payoff amount <USD with 2 decimals>." The quote id is the reference number of the new quote; the quote date is today; the presence of the quote id means the quote was recorded.

## Points of reading

- The quote date is always the day the tool is called; it is not a parameter.
- A refinance-purpose quote uses `refinance` as its purpose; a quote the borrower will pay directly uses `borrower_payoff`.
